titleEn: Angry? Breathe Out a White Cloud!

pages.text: "I will make a snowball bigger than me!" Impatient Bobo rolled snow in the yard. The snowball was already knee-high. Teacher Bau of Rainbow Class watched from the middle of the yard.
Bobo pressed more snow on with both hands. "A little more rolling, and it really will be bigger than me!" The snowball reached Bobo's tummy.
Pushing hard, Bobo slipped. One side of the snowball crumbled. "My snowball!" Bobo shouted.
Bobo yanked the hat brim forward and stamped hard. Gathering a handful of snow, Bobo raised an arm. Careless Duri, packing snow nearby, took two steps back.
Teacher Bau knelt in the snow beside Bobo. "Bobo, did you suddenly grow hot inside?" Holding the snow, Bobo nodded deeply.
Teacher Bau rounded their mouth and blew out. A long white breath streamed away. "Heat goes out like this. Angry? Breathe out a white cloud!" Bobo's eyes grew round.
Bobo copied: in through the nose, out through the mouth. White breath stretched ahead. "Angry? Breathe out a white cloud!" After three times, the snow fell from Bobo's hand.
Bobo looked at Duri. "I am sorry... for shouting." Duri tugged the neckerchief knot. "It is all right. Let us roll together!" They added snow to the broken side together.
As they rolled again, the snowball cracked. Bobo opened fingers to count. "One, stop my hands! Two, breathe in! Three, breathe out!" When the white cloud drifted out, Bobo rolled again.

Teacher Bau wrapped both arms around Bobo and Duri together. "Anger can go out like a cloud of breath." Even angry, you can blow out instead of throwing. Breathing out together, they called, "Angry? Breathe out a white cloud!"
